title: A Bayesian machine learning approach to direct and spillover effects in cluster-randomized trials with noncompliance
abstract: arXiv:2610.27425v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop a Bayesian machine learning approach for estimating direct and spillover effects in cluster-randomized trials with treatment noncompliance. To flexibly model outcomes and treatment receipt while accounting for within-cluster dependence, we combine Bayesian additive regression trees with cluster-level random effects. We augment the outcome regression with a peer-treatment clever covariate, defined as the predicted mean proportion of treated peers from a preliminary receipt model, to mitigate regularization-induced distortion of the effect decomposition. Within a Bayesian g-computation framework, we estimate cluster-average intent-to-treat effects and cluster-average local average treatment effects and examine sensitivity to the cross-world restrictions underlying their decomposition. translated_title: 一种用于存在不依从性的整群随机试验中直接效应与溢出效应估计的贝叶斯机器学习方法
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一种贝叶斯机器学习方法，用于在存在治疗不依从性的整群随机试验中估计直接效应和溢出效应。为了在考虑簇内相关性的同时灵活地建模结局和治疗接受情况，我们将贝叶斯可加回归树与簇级随机效应相结合。我们通过一个同伴治疗巧妙协变量来增强结局回归，该协变量定义为由初步接受模型预测的同伴接受治疗比例的均值，以减轻正则化所引起的效应分解失真。在贝叶斯g-计算框架内，我们估计了簇平均意向治疗效应和簇平均局部平均治疗效应，并检验了对其分解所依据的跨世界限制的敏感性。模拟研究表明，在模型误设情况下偏差有所降低，而正确设定的参数模型则表现出预期的频率学派性质。
tldr: 该论文提出一种将贝叶斯可加回归树与簇级随机效应相结合、并引入同伴治疗巧妙协变量的贝叶斯机器学习方法，在贝叶斯g-计算框架下估计存在不依从性的整群随机试验中的直接效应与溢出效应，并在模型误设时显著降低偏差。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a Bayesian machine learning approach combining Bayesian additive regression trees with cluster-level random effects and a peer-treatment clever covariate within a Bayesian g-computation framework to estimate direct and spillover effects in cluster-randomized trials with noncompliance, reducing bias under model misspecification.
